notes.title: Version 3.71
notes.content:
We know it’s been a while since you’ve heard from us, but trust us when we say we have not been resting on our laurels. We are currently working on two significant projects for you all. For those that don’t know QI Sports does not only want to make an excellent place for fans of the beautiful game but also have an ice hockey community too! We are currently working on adapting what we built for that world of ice and speed onto the same core platform that runs Kickoff Legends. As if that was not enough we are also working on bringing Kickoff Legends onto iOS. Both projects are advancing well, and a lot of this new build concerns those projects.

But here's a list of what you can already enjoy now!
[list][*]We have worked hard on speeding up real-time connections between you and the server as well as you and your opponents, we are hoping to wrap up another speed-up project within the next few days[/*][*]We have added staff level-up notifications and wall posts[/*][*]We have added new League Rewards (passer, tackler, and bully) so now every aspect of the player league leaderboard is rewarded.[/*][*]Changed Subs icon in Game Scene[/*][*]Display Subs on live matches on wall[/*][*]One Free Item for each new team, this means that when someone creates a team, they receive one free bonus item to improve their team. Tell all your friends! They just might beat you on their first day (if they play their strategies right that is off course). Always remember for each friend that you bring to Kickoff Legends, you get rewarded[/*][/list]
Also, always remember, the game is available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.studioqi.kickofflegends]Android[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/542940/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.kickofflegends.com/]the browser[/url]! So all your friends can play too! You can start on any platform and continue playing on another and all platforms can play against each other!

Now get back out there!

notes.title: Version 3.70
notes.content:
With the onset of spring we give you a new feature that opens up a whole new chapter to how you manage your very own team towards glory! Here go!


A team needs leadership, and some things you, as the one in charge, need to be able to delegate. You need qualified staff that executes your directions and helps you make the right decisions. Starting today, you can add staff to your team. Excited? You should Be!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/K1F7X9F.png[/img]


The first member you will be able to add is the Assistant Manager! Unlike players, you don’t have to worry about your staff signing with a new team while still under contract with you. So your assistant manager will be saying with you until the very end of the contract, if you choose to renew the contract you don’t have to worry about being outbid.


You can only sign one Assistant Manager for your team, the same rules will apply for future staff members.


By playing matches your Assistant Managers gains experience and will level up. With each level new abilities will be unlocked. We are starting with 2 levels today, but 5 levels are planned right now and in development.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/bX1QG3z.png[/img]


This update offers you two advantages that will make your team more competitive than ever. At level 1, if your Assistant Manager can automatically assign training points as soon as a training ends. Once at level 2, he increases the maximum number of active items at the same time.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/rLTaUwu.png[/img]


Your assistant manager will also interact on the technical, physical, mental and goalkeeper aspects as we continue to develop this feature, so make sure you start working on his evolution today. Our long-term goal is to add many more staff members. What we have planned right now are the banker, a therapist, specialist coaches, a director of football and a negotiator. As you can see, this is just the beginning! Hire your Assistant Manager from the market right now, coach your team and win the league!


Also, always remember, the game is available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.studioqi.kickofflegends]Android[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/542940/]Steam[/url] and [url=../]the browser[/url]! So all your friends can play too! You can start on any platform and continue playing on another and all platforms can play against each other!

Now get back out there!

notes.title: Version 3.69
notes.content:
How do they say? Progress never stops? Those that play Kickoff Legends on Steam or via the Browser will already have noticed that the Game has become noticeably faster as we upgraded the way that data is being loaded. 

We just completed the finishing touches implementing this into the Android Application as well, you can start testing this right away if you sign up as a Beta tester in the Play Store. Full roll-out will be coming soon.

Furthermore, as the wall is becoming more and more crowded with your own and other teams content, it is important to be able to get to what is important to you right here and now. You will notice three new buttons on top of the News feed. [b]Global[/b], is the wall you know, all events and posts are displayed here. [b]League[/b], will only be showing news about your own and teams playing in the same league you are playing in. [b]My Team[/b], only shows events about your own team. Ultimately we want you to be able to create your own filters, so you can build feed that is just right for you, but this should help you get to what’s important when it’s important. 

Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. Do you miss a strategy? Do you want a specific type of player. Do you think that players need a new ability? [url=https://www.facebook.com/kickofflegends/]Get in touch[/url] and let us know!

Also, always remember, the game is available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.studioqi.kickofflegends]Android[/url], [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/542940/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.kickofflegends.com/]the browser[/url]! notes.title: Version 3.68
notes.content:
To start the week off right, we have big announcements to make! We’ve been working on several changes that will definitely influence the way you’re playing your matches.

As you know KOL’s goal is to put you in charge. It is up to you to make the right decision at the right time! As soccer fans, you know the importance of half time. It's a crucial moment for the managers and players alike. 

Now, with these new updates, you can have a real half time talk with your team in the locker room! You can replace them during this key period just like in a real game. 

Also, if your strategy isn't the best, you can review your tactics and rewrite history! Change your 4-3-3 for an offensive 4-4-2 and get the glory! 

Now, when you analyze your player stats, you will have the team’s lineup average at the top of the page. This will help you make the right decisions for your team and make sure your strategies are the best! Your selected starting lineup strength is in your team header. In the mobile application it is always visible in the footer.

There’s even more that comes with this build, because it’s all about the little things. Player lists (Team Players, Contracts and Lineup) are now sorted by positions by default, no more using the filter to find the right player. your players are now grouped by Goaltenders, Defenders, Midfielders and Attackers. 

Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. Do you miss a strategy? Do you want a specific type of player. Do you think that players need a new ability? [url=https://www.facebook.com/kickofflegends/]Get in touch[/url] and let us know!

Also, the game is available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.studioqi.kickofflegends]Android,[/url] [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/542940/]Steam[/url] and [url=../]the browser[/url]!

Now get back out there!

notes.title: Version 3.67.3
notes.content:
Hello Kickoff lovers, for Valentine’s Day, we’ve thought flowers were not as good as new updates in your favourite game routine! 
Starting from now, your team is going to be in a better shape than usual since players will restore 1% of stamina every 5 minutes. 
Never change your habits...for those who use Firefox, the rendering issues have been fixed for your viewing pleasure. 

Sometimes you get bored of our avatar and you like changes...did you have some trouble to change your avatar recently? You don’t have to worry anymore. You want a picture of Neymar? Cristiano Ronaldo? Or even Lionel Messi, everything is possible! Also, it will be so much fun to watch your live game now. Bye bye interruptions!  

In soccer these days, everything is about business right?! Well, guess what?! Now you’ll have to be more strategic in the way you deal with your budget cause the initial star player salaries are increased. 
Happy Valentine’s Day to all of you and don’t forget to give some love to your team too!

Being in charge of a team you need not only to make the right decision during a match, but you also need to plan ahead. Today’s release helps you with with just that!
[list][*]We have replaced the Player Offers section with Contracts, you will now be able to see how your team will look like in the next 5 seasons! Make sure that your team respects the salary cap. notes.title: Version 3.44 - Energy!
notes.content:
This version, called [b]Energy[/b], brings some [b]very[/b] important changes to the energy of the players.

At the end of your match, the energy of your player will be saved and a fraction of the energy lost will be applied to your player. When starting your next match, your player will start with that energy. Quick and easy example :

Magnus Haug from the StudioQi team ends his match at 58% energy. 
When starting a new match, Magnus will start his new match at 90%. When this match ends, he has 25% of energy.
When starting the third match, his energy will be 50%.

The process to recover is pretty easy, put your player as a sub or remove it completly from line up. As long as a player doesn't play in a match, he will recover energy. We want to force people to change their lineup instead of having 12 good players and winning the cup with it.

In the next releases we will be focusing on player content (commenting on match result and achievements, league discussions, etc). Following that, we will start introducing Staff.

Some Staff will help you to loose less energy or recover energy faster.

As a side note, we have heard numerous reports about the game not giving enough Millions to keep a good competitive team alive and well. We are investigating into the issue and trying to address to issue. More news coming soon. As usual, if you find a bug, have some ideas or just want to chat, connect with us via Facebook.

notes.title: Version 3.40
notes.content:
When building your dynasty it's important to convince your players to stick around to see the project until the end. There is a famous saying, and it goes like so "Money talks!". When you offer one of your own players a contract you can now offer them a non-compete clause. This means that the player will not be taking any more offers from any other teams. Gone are the days of exclusive Friday's but at least you can hold on to your player if you are willing to pay him to stay. 

On to the full list of new features: 
[list]
[*]Golden generation to boost average of players older than 32 years
[*]New kids on the block to boost average of players younger than 22
[*]Shin pads to improve player tackling
[*]Different shoes to boost player speed/passing/shooting 
[*]Goal keeper gloves to improve your goalies Technical abilities
[*]Speed up the match up in the lobby, opponent (or bot) now joins the game much faster
[*]When you click fast forward during a match, the 
[*]You can now purchase energy drinks to boost your players stamina
[*]You can now login with Steam from the game site. Start playing in steam then pick up the same match from another machine!
[*]New non-compete clause to player offer. If you want to make a final offer to a player, you can pay an additional amount to freeze the offers. Only works if this is your player. This also means that we are removing the Friday offer freeze, in favor of the new non-compete clause.
[*]New Inventory widget in the header of the dashboard. Always make sure you have an active item to give your team the best possible chance when playing a match!
[/list]

Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. So [url=https://www.facebook.com/kickofflegends/]get in touch[/url] and let us know where you would like to see changes!

Also, remember the game is also available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.studioqi.kickofflegends]Android[/url] and [url=https://www.kickofflegends.com]Browser[/url]!

[*]New non-compete clause to player offer. If you want to make a final offer to a player, you can pay an additional amount to freeze the offers. Only works if this is your player. This also means that we are removing the Friday offer freeze, in favor of the new non-compete clause.
[*]New Inventory widget in the header of the dashboard. Always make sure you have an active item to give your team the best possible chance when playing a match!
[/list]

Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. So [url=https://www.facebook.com/kickofflegends/]get in touch[/url] and let us know where you would like to see changes!

Also, remember the game is also available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.studioqi.kickofflegends]Android[/url] and [url=https://www.kickofflegends.com]Browser[/url]!

notes.title: Release 3.38.1
notes.content:
Sorry about these three posts in one go. We just completely forgot publishing our release notes here. 

There’s been an issue with the user status manager making it hard to know whether your friends or the admins actually where online. We’re hoping this is fixed now, so chatting with and challenging friends should be much easier again now!

We have restructured the the menu a bit to make room for a new feature. The Market Menu now holds the Player Market as well as the newly added Team Boost items.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26689010/6e0d2247524796e95656b038e4f95ffe3ee23c7b.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26689010/f96496d19c55a0d99752b1926080ed663f96240a.png[/img][/url]

These boosters are the first of many that will be added gradually over the next month, if you have any specific ones you would like to see, please do not hesitate to let us know. We can’t do this without you guys!

See you on the pitch!

notes.title: Release 3.35
notes.content:
We’re continuing to overhaul the interface to make Kickoff Legends an even better experience this time around. We all start with a clean slate when joining the game, what is important to is to train and shape the team according to your own taste to prove that you know better. So always having players in training is crucial. With this release you now speed up an ongoing training.

Also, note the question mark on the right of the training dialog which gives you some information about where to distribute the points depending on where you want your player to excel!

The second element we have added to the league calendar to the Dashboard, this will give new users an easy way to see how important the week is and for those of you already in a league it gives you a quick overview on how your week is going in your league

See you on the pitch!

notes.title: Version 3.34
notes.content:
You thought things weren’t changing? Boy are you wrong, it’s just so much we can barely keep up these last weeks, it’s also the reason why we have been so silent in general. Full steam ahead. 

So without going into too many details here are some of the highlights:

Massive speed-up of game in general. The more users we had the more Kickoff Legends was slowing down. We have addressed this with some ninja request handling that brings a tear to our CTOs eye every time he gets to talk about it. 

Early last months we followed up on that optimization bout with a new and improved wall on the Dashboard, initially combining Release Notes, Team Creation News with Matches. We have now improved this, and a lot more will be happening on the Wall over the coming releases. 

Isn't it nice to have friends rivals, not only is it more fun playing against other Teams managed by real fans, but you also get a much fatter reward at the end of the game!

Well our latest release is all about you and your friends and rivals. We have, as promised, continued working on the wall on the Dashboard. When a friend signs, trains or buys a player, you''l know about it! When a friend completes and claims an objective and game- or league-achievement, you'll know about it! 

Keep an eye on the competition as you work your way to the top. Always remember that we can't do this without your feedback, it's what keeps us up at night. So get in touch and let us know where you would like to see changes!

See you on the pitch!

We have been very silent in the past weeks, we have been working on our big feature, the news wall! This wall, for now, displays freshly created teams, new players signed by your team, news (like this one) and all live or recently completed matches. notes.title: Version 3.27
notes.content:
Boy, do we have news for you! It’s been a long time in the making but the league pyramid is finally ready for you to climb! How does it work you ask? Simple, finish in the top 5 of your current league and off you go to the next level! 

As for the bug fixes, we fixed the two leg reward system. People would always get the reward if you're playing against the same opponent more than one time.
User settings page is now saving for Steam users.

See you on the pitch!

notes.title: Version 3.25 and 3.26
notes.content:
Releasing 3.25 and migrating to new servers last Monday was so exciting we forgot to publish the patch notes! So here is 3.25 from Monday and the new version released today, 3.26:

[h1]3.25[/h1] 
[list]
[*]A first iteration of the achievement system. In your Team section you will now get a list of achievements allowing you to continue to work your way towards glory!
[*]New web notifications! We have added browser notifications to the game for those of you using that as your primary client. 
[*]Small refresh to the design
[*]Added Goals and played matches to your team player list
[*]Move game to new servers.
[/list]

[h1]3.26[/h1] 

This one goes hand in hand with the other release made last Monday. It adds 4 new achievements and a few fixes about the new achievement page. Hope you like it!

[list]
[*]The Spender : Buy 5 free agents from the market.
[*]The Galacticos : Buy 11 Star player in the market! The price doesn't matter, but it needs to be a star player.
[*]No longer friends : Beat your friends 50 times. If you value your friendship, we suggest you beat different friends :)
[*]The Mad Hatter (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond) : Five levels for this achievement, every time you score a hat trick you get closer to marvellous rewards.
[/list]

We are looking closely at the stability of the game on the new servers, but if you notice something weird, please do contact us!
See you on the pitch!

notes.title: Version 3.24
notes.content:
Happy new year to y'all! 2017. We have three new formations for you to best meet your opponents. We will be adding more as time passes. Please feel free to request new ones too! So without any further ado, here we go!

 - Tutorial all displayed on dashboard instead of moving all around the site. No longer triggering a fast forward at the end of the first match. This should help new owners to better enter the game. 
 - Following user requests we give younew formations! 3-4-3, 4-3-2-1, 4-2-3-1. Want more? Just ask!
 
 Bug fixes
 - Challenges are now working correctly
 - No longer re-assigning jersey numbers on lineup change. Special thanks to Parcselona for this one!

We are developing at breakneck speed deploying a new version at least once week, more often twice. So off course we want to make sure that our focus is at the right place. So in short, if you could take a moment to fill out this form (see link in-game) it would really be helpful to use as we move forward. To make it a little interesting the 5 best answers will receive a $25 Amazon Gift certificate. The winners will be announced on the [url=https://www.facebook.com/kickofflegends]Kickoff Legends Facebook Page[/url].

As always, if you have an Android device, install the app! If you have a problem with the game send us a message on Facebook, Twitter or the Steam Community.

As usual, if you questions, issues or ideas, please contact us!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26689010/63f765011f52a48e0cd6e74e76ff1329852b2e66.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 3.23
notes.content:

This one brings a few new features :

Even faster fast forward! Try it and let us know what you think!


As for the bug fixes:

- Major issue about team creation on Android

As usual, if you questions, issues or ideas, [url=https://m.me/kickofflegends]please contact us[/url] or leave us a message in the Steam Community!
